title: The Power of Small Words
text:
Linking words help writers connect their ideas and make a text easier to follow. For example, however shows a contrast, while therefore shows a result. Moreover, additional words such as furthermore add extra information to an argument. Without these connectors, a text can feel like a list of unrelated sentences.

Students often use linking words in essays, but they sometimes choose the wrong one. Consequently, the reader may become confused about the writer's meaning. A good strategy is to read your paragraph aloud and check whether each connector matches the relationship between your ideas. Although it takes time, this habit improves both clarity and accuracy.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, what do linking words help writers do?
What does the second paragraph say that students sometimes do?
options: Check their spelling in a dictionary

questions.text: Why would a text without connectors be hard to follow?
options: Its ideas would seem unrelated to each other
It would contain too many examples
It would only use past tense verbs
It would be written in a dictionary style

questions.text: What can the reader infer about a writer who reads their paragraph aloud?
options: They want to check whether their connectors fit their ideas
They plan to shorten the paragraph
They are preparing a speech for an audience
They have finished the essay and are ready to submit it

vocabulary.definition: used to show a contrast with what was said before
in addition to what has already been said
the quality of being clear and easy to understand

paragraph_translations: Bağlaçlar, yazarların fikirlerini birbirine bağlamasına yardımcı olur ve bir metnin takip edilmesini kolaylaştırır. Örneğin 'however' bir karşıtlık, 'therefore' ise bir sonuç gösterir. 'Moreover' ve 'furthermore' gibi ek ifadeler bir argümana ek bilgi katar. Bu bağlaçlar olmadan bir metin, birbirinden kopuk cümlelerin bir listesi gibi hissettirebilir.

Öğrenciler denemelerinde sık sık bağlaçları kullanır, ancak bazen yanlış olanı seçerler. Sonuç olarak okuyucu, yazarın anlatmak istediğini karıştırabilir. İyi bir strateji, paragrafı yüksek sesle okuyup her bağlaçın fikirler arasındaki ilişkiyle uyuşup uyuşmadığını kontrol etmektir. Zaman alsa da bu alışkanlık hem açıklığı hem de doğruluğu geliştirir.
